name: getsid
description: getsid() returns the session ID of the process with the specified process ID. If pid is 0, it returns the session ID of the calling process.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The process ID; if 0, returns the session ID of the calling process.

return_value.success: Returns the session ID on success
return_value.failure: Returns (pid_t)-1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: A process with process ID pid exists, but it is not in the same session as the calling process, and the implementation considers this an error.
No process with process ID pid was found.
